alternatives.name: PUBLIC_CATALYST_WHALE_EVENT_WITH_INFERRED_CONFIDENCE
tradeoffs: Catalyst signals remain INFERRED with explicit gate reasons; no paper execution or trade recommendations are encoded.

negative: Catalyst confidence and lean are derived heuristics; they must not be presented as execution signals.
positive: public_catalyst family can surface entitled fixture catalyst events with honest gate_reasons and PIT cutoff semantics.

decision.summary: Public-catalyst whale events use whale_event payloads with family public_catalyst, catalyst_type, headline, source, confidence (INFERRED), lean, direction_label (supports_long|supports_short|neutral), gate_ok, gate_reasons (CONFIDENCE_BELOW_THRESHOLD, LEAN_NEUTRAL, LIQUIDITY_INSUFFICIENT), and signal_source. PIT queries exclude events whose available_time exceeds prediction_cutoff. Outputs are research-only context, not trade recommendations.
decision.title: Public catalyst whale envelope semantics and gate policy

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: Acceptance authorizes fixture-first public_catalyst on ADMITTED-CATALYST-BOXL-001 only. Live news feeds and paper execution require separate entitlement records.
